transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?
I'm here because... well, I just feel like I'm always running hot. Like I can't shut the motor off, I guess. And, um, lately that's been getting me in trouble at the firehouse.
When you’re feeling this way, do you sleep less than usual without feeling tired?
No, not really. I mean, I sleep. When I can. It's just hard to wind down sometimes. But I definitely feel tired if I don't get enough.
Do you use any stimulant drugs, such as cocaine, meth, or non-prescribed ADHD medication?
No. I don't do any of that.
Have you experienced or witnessed a traumatic event that these symptoms seem to be connected to?
No. I mean... obviously I see things at work, but... no. Nothing like that.
Did these attention or restlessness problems start when you were a child?

Yeah, I guess so. My mom says I was like this back in grade school, too. Always getting out of my seat, blurting out answers before the teacher finished asking... losing my homework. She got a lot of notes sent home about it, even though they always said I was bright enough to do the work. Just... couldn't sit still, I guess.
